stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists in the sequenced samples. GSE269053 holds 21 LV RNA-seq samples split only by diet (chow/HFD) and AAV8-Renin (novirus/Renin); the paper uses exercise solely as a treadmill-exhaustion phenotyping readout (S2.2.p4, S4.5.p1, FIG2H), not as an intervention on sequenced animals, and no per-sample exercise variable is deposited. The requested estimand (effect of exercise on gene expression) cannot be identified from these data; any diet or renin contrast would be a different estimand.
